verdict.rationale: cubic's own fix agent generates code fixes from review comments and pushes commits to the PR branch. That covers committing within an existing PR, and the AI wiki is kept current through a cubic-maintained rolling pull request. Nothing shows a developer directing the agent to stage arbitrary changes, write commit messages, create branches, or open general-purpose PRs; doc 51 refers to the user running normal Git commands themselves. Missing for 10: agent-driven staging, documented commit-message authoring, branch creation, opening arbitrary new PRs on request, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent stage changes, write commit messages, create branches, and open pull requests
